definitions.PASS: FDA approval action for the specific application review cycle on or before the original publicly disclosed PDUFA goal; not simply absence of CRL
definitions.CRL: FDA Complete Response Letter for the same review cycle on or before that goal
definitions.EXTENSION: Formally communicated FDA PDUFA goal extension for the same cycle, known on or before the original goal; not ordinary delayed reporting or future ultimate approval

requiredIndependentChecks: complete application and review-cycle cohort roster including no calls
original PDUFA goal and each revision sourced by first publication date
source-fact availability prior to the forecast cutoff
independent outcome adjudication from FDA primary records
independent sponsor/application identity and issuer family disjointness
locked model and threshold version prior to holdout outcomes
warnings: A retrospective 146-case history is not a blind validation set.
The three-way target is original-goal disposition, not ultimate FDA approval after an extension.
An unverified extension cannot be inferred from an approval after its scheduled PDUFA target.
Research percentages are not accuracy claims until frozen prospective decisions and a complete eligible denominator are independently certified.
